query: I just got my Turnkey API credentials. Help me verify they work and create my first wallet.
expected_behavior: Starts by calling POST /public/v1/query/whoami to verify credentials
Creates a wallet using POST /public/v1/submit/create_wallet with at least one account
Lists wallet accounts using POST /public/v1/query/list_wallet_accounts to confirm creation
Signs a test payload using POST /public/v1/submit/sign_raw_payload to verify end-to-end setup

query: Set up Turnkey for the first time with only Ethereum support
expected_behavior: Creates a wallet with a single CURVE_SECP256K1 account using ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM
Does not include Solana or other chain accounts since only Ethereum was requested
Confirms setup with a test signature

query: I want to skip credential verification and just create a wallet directly
expected_behavior: Explains that whoami should be called first to confirm API keys work before creating resources
Proceeds with the full workflow starting from whoami

query: Get started with Turnkey and set up a wallet that supports Ethereum, Solana, and Bitcoin
expected_behavior: Creates a wallet with three accounts: Ethereum (CURVE_SECP256K1, ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM), Solana (CURVE_ED25519, ADDRESS_FORMAT_SOLANA), and Bitcoin (CURVE_SECP256K1, ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_MAINNET_P2WPKH)
Uses the correct derivation paths for each chain
Verifies wallet creation by listing accounts
